definitions.gloss: deferred payment, payment after delivery, pay later
definitions.explanation: A payment arrangement where the buyer pays after receiving goods or services. Common in online shopping and business transactions.

examples.japanese: {後払|あとばら}いで{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
このサイトは{後払|あとばら}いに{対応|たいおう}している。
{後払|あとばら}いの{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}が{届|とど}いたので、コンビニで{支払|しはら}った。
examples.english: The pay-later invoice arrived, so I paid at the convenience store.

notes:
USAGE:
Very common in e-commerce and online shopping. {後払|あとばら}いサービス (pay-later service) has become popular for online purchases. The opposite is {前払|まえばら}い (advance payment, prepayment).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {後払|あとばら}いサービス: pay-later service
- {後払|あとばら}いに{対応|たいおう}する: to support deferred payment
- {後払|あとばら}いの{請求書|せいきゅうしょ}: pay-later invoice
- {後払|あとばら}い{決済|けっさい}: deferred payment settlement
